title: VALUE ( "1,234" ) is 1234

source.quote: The value passed as the text parameter can be in any of the constant, number, date, or time formats recognized by the application or services you are using
source.supports: VALUE accepts the number formats the engine recognizes; the page does not list them

source.quote: The converted number in decimal data type

derivation: VALUE accepts the number formats the engine recognizes. In en-US 1,234 is the usual way to write 1234, so it is taken as recognized. VALUE returns a decimal number: 1234.0.
alternative: No source says whether a group separator is accepted. If it is not, VALUE returns an error.
